description: Add a comment to a Confluence page: a footer comment on the page, an inline comment anchored to a piece of the page's text with inline_text, or a reply to an existing footer or inline comment with parent_comment_id. A reply goes into the same kind of thread as the comment it answers. An inline_text that does not appear in the page is refused before anything is posted; when it appears more than once, inline_match picks which. Returns the new comment's ID, version, type and parent.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

body.description:
Comment text (plain text; will be wrapped in

tags automatically).

inline_match.description: Which occurrence of inline_text to anchor to, counting from 1, when it appears more than once (default 1).

inline_text.description: Optional text on the page to anchor an inline comment to, exactly as it reads on the page. Not used with parent_comment_id.

page_id.description: The ID of the page to comment on.

parent_comment_id.description: Optional ID of an existing comment, footer or inline, to reply to.

name: atlassian-mcp__confluence_add_comment
